title: Aros Group unveils a hinged paper makeup case with an adjustable mirror
summary: Aros Group, formerly known as Jujin New York, received two distinctions at the 2026 Pentawards for Paper Palette, a paper-based compact built around a proprietary, patent-pending hinge that holds the lid, and its mirror, steady at any angle the user chooses. The result brings the precise, confident movement of a premium compact to a mono-material paper structure designed for circularity.
